subject: Operations
title: Reorder Points
description: A fast breakdown of Reorder Points for builders.

hook.text: Two eggs left in the fridge. You need a dozen for the weekend. When should you have ordered? Yesterday.

buildup.text: A reorder point is the inventory level that triggers a new order. Set it too low and you run out.

discovery.text: Reorder point equals daily demand times lead time plus safety stock. It accounts for resupply time.

twist.text: If lead time is uncertain, the reorder point must rise. Variability forces bigger buffers.

climax.text: Automated systems track inventory in real time and trigger orders at the exact reorder point, day or night.

punchline.text: Order before you need it. That's the whole trick.

quiz.question: What does a reorder point determine?
options: When to place a new order
